skills/cco.description: In Claude Code: what this session costs and where the tokens go, plus the tools to cut it — /cco for the board, /cco audit, /cco task, /cco pack and more. Use when the user asks about session cost, context size, savings, or wants a task tracked across /compact.

skills/doc-digest.description: Turn a long document, PDF, transcript, spreadsheet or log into a compact working digest the conversation can continue from. Use when the user shares or pastes something long (several pages or more) and wants to discuss, analyze, compare or use it over more than one message, or asks to summarize a document so they can keep working with it.

skills/fresh-start.description: Continue in a new chat without losing anything — writes a compact handoff to paste into a fresh conversation. Use whenever the user wants to move to a new chat or conversation, hits usage limits, says replies got slow or Claude forgets earlier details, or the conversation has grown long.

skills/project-context.description: Turn background the user keeps re-explaining or re-pasting into reusable instructions, so new chats start with it for free. Use when the user repeats the same context, rules, style guide, persona or reference text across messages or chats, says they are tired of explaining the same thing, or asks how to set up a Claude Project, custom instructions or a CLAUDE.md.

skills/sharpen-prompt.description: Rewrite a vague request into a precise prompt — goal, context, scope, constraints, what done looks like, output format. Use when the user asks to improve, rewrite, sharpen or check a prompt.

skills/token-check.description: Estimate how many tokens a pasted text, an attached file or the conversation so far takes, what it means for the context window and usage limits, and how to cut it. Use when the user asks how big something is in tokens, why they keep hitting limits, or whether a file is too large to send.
